name: DestinX Product Configurator for WooCommerce
author: destinx

sections.description:
DestinX Product Configurator helps WooCommerce store owners create guided product configuration experiences from reusable templates.

With DestinX Product Configurator you can:

  • Create and manage reusable configuration templates
  • Organize choices into guided steps and option groups
  • Use select, radio, swatch, checkbox, and boolean choices
  • Add a simple price adjustment to each option
  • Assign templates to WooCommerce products
  • Use the WooCommerce product price and standard product quantity
  • Display a live recap on the product page
  • Store the selected configuration in the cart, checkout, and order
  • Start from a bundled example template
  • Choose Minimal for progressive choices, product descriptions and native WooCommerce reviews
  • Keep the product gallery or show the image associated with the selected option
  • Keep quantity and total within reach with a responsive purchase bar

The plugin works independently after activation and does not require a license, account, or external service.

All bundled DestinX logos, demo images, and documentation screenshots are original works by Destinx and are distributed under GPLv2 or later with this plugin.

WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Automattic Inc.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install the plugin from WordPress.org or upload its ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate DestinX Product Configurator for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Product Configurator in the WordPress admin area and create or import a template.
  5. Assign the template to a WooCommerce product and test the product page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. It extends WooCommerce product pages and requires WooCommerce to be active.

Does the plugin work on its own?

Yes. Every feature included in this WordPress.org package is available immediately after activation. There are no license checks or locked controls.

How is the configured price calculated?

The WooCommerce product price is used as the base. Any price adjustments assigned to the selected options are added per product quantity.

Does this plugin contact an external service?

No. It does not send store data to Destinx for licensing, updates, telemetry, or font loading.

How do I enable Minimal and dynamic images?

Open Options > Layout, select Minimal, and choose the image source under Minimal product images. WooCommerce product gallery keeps the product images and thumbnails. Selected option image displays the last selected option that has a valid image, falling back to another selected image or the product image when needed. Existing installations keep their current layout and the gallery is the default image source.

What is not included in this package?

This package does not include matrix pricing, CSV price imports, conditional field filters, quote/PDF workflows, or production worksheets. There are no locked controls or license checks for these implementations in the WordPress.org package.

0.9.28.3

  • Protect customer artwork with encrypted storage and authenticated downloads; add bounded migration, storage quotas and expiry cleanup.
  • Enforce public product access and validated reorder configuration across product pages, saved configurations, pricing and cart requests.
  • Keep WooCommerce variation selection available in embedded Elementor Pro product templates, including templates with a native Add to Cart widget.
  • Isolate selections and preview files when multiple configurators appear on the same page.
  • Initialize dynamically inserted configurators without duplicate controls or handlers, and restore Escape-key dismissal and keyboard focus.
  • Keep Classic and Minimal mobile purchase controls above the Storefront footer.
  • Preserve the original configurator styling across themes and builders, and keep headings and quantity controls readable inside narrow columns.

0.9.28.2

  • Keep option prices, labels and preview images distinct when different fields reuse the same option ID.
  • Restore saved artwork, share links and selected variation attributes, including supported wildcard variations.
  • Keep native variation selectors, live totals and purchase controls synchronized after restoring or changing a variation.
  • Accept authenticated Store API configurations when WooCommerce resolves a parent product and attributes to a variation.
  • Preserve negative option adjustments in saved totals, calculate saved prices on the server and floor the final product price at zero.
  • Apply consistent quantity limits when a product minimum exceeds the template maximum, while preserving WooCommerce stock restrictions.
  • Allow optional steps to remain blank in non-Minimal layouts without hiding later required choices or blocking purchase.
  • Improve narrow recap buttons and completion text, and prevent the Minimal layout from overlapping retained theme content.

0.9.28.1

  • Fix a recursive price lookup that could exhaust PHP memory on product and category pages containing configurable products with an empty WooCommerce price.
  • Preserve existing empty-price behavior and avoid applying display taxes inside the raw price fallback.

0.9.28.0

  • Add the Minimal layout with progressive fields, editable previous choices, short and long descriptions, and native WooCommerce reviews.
  • Add a choice between product gallery images and a single image tied to the selected option, with image fallbacks.
  • Preserve the complete Live price preview and hide the fixed quantity/total bar while the preview is visible.
  • Improve narrow-screen spacing, option-card alignment, touch controls and keyboard focus when hiding the bar.
  • Keep native variation selectors usable in Minimal, including WooCommerce’s required table and inert gallery template markup.
  • Include the maintenance fixes from 0.9.27.18.

  • Fix: preserve the native WooCommerce product layout when there is no usable configurator.
  • Fix: use the product and customer WooCommerce tax context, including zero, reduced, compound and exempt tax cases.
  • Fix: enforce configured quantity limits during classic and Store API cart updates and checkout.
  • Fix: validate Store API JSON configurations, nonces and saved artwork before adding items.
  • Fix: prevent public request quota bypass through User-Agent or untrusted proxy headers.
  • Fix: retain direct artwork uploads between cart validation and cart item creation.

  • Fixed page titles for the hidden Template Editor and Getting Started administration screens on WordPress 7.1 and PHP 8.3.
  • Restored the original animated product-configurator icon used on the DestinX website.

  • Added the two official YouTube tutorials to the plugin page, Getting Started screen, and bundled documentation.
  • Made every administrative AJAX nonce check explicitly terminate invalid requests before processing input.
  • Kept capability checks in place for all protected template-management actions.

  • Simplified template import/export nonce validation so it occurs before request data is processed.
  • Applied late escaping to every settings field name and to AJAX error messages before inserting them into the admin interface.

  • Made admin and frontend nonce validation explicit before request data is processed.
